name: El Paso
registryBasis: The City of El Paso Open Data Hub says parcel shapefiles are maintained by El Paso Central Appraisal District (EPCAD); the City GIS exposes a public Parcels polygon layer. A bounded query returned one safe OBJECTID and polygon near the WUP point. This is not a citywide completeness or legal-title claim.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
scopeLimits: 79 valid, distinct EPCAD-source parcel reference polygons served by City of El Paso GIS, qualified in thirteen bounded cells around the unchanged WUP population-settlement locator. Complete native count and object-ID manifests, forced three-row pages, all fresh GIS-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding pass. Metric EPSG32613 topology found no sampled overlaps or errors. A fresh native parcel contains the locator, which is also within the official city limits. The layer is county-source/city-publisher ground geometry, not a city-only or legal-title coverage guarantee.
remainingUncertainty: Legal title, survey accuracy, currentness and full settlement or municipality completeness remain unverified.
